text:
acme_bob: Hey, noticed a regression after yesterday's model rollout. Same user prompt in a session is returning previous-conversation content instead of the expected answer. Happens intermittently but reproducible for some sessions.

acme_bob: Example: two consecutive requests with same conversation_id -> second reply pulls text from an unrelated earlier convo.

acme_bob: curl test we ran: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-instruct-2b","conversation_id":"acme-1234","input":"Summarize the last invoice."}'
```

acme_bob: First response (correct): "Summary: invoice 2026-02-28 ..."
acme_bob: Second response (wrong): "On the sales meeting last Tuesday ..." — totally unrelated.

alice_support: Sorry about that — we'll investigate. Can you share the conversation_id, exact timestamps, and the tenant id? Also did you see any errors/503s around the same time?

acme_bob: conversation_id acme-1234, tenant ACME_INC, timestamps 1781999000-1781999300, no 5xx seen. Token usage looks normal.

alice_support: Pinged eng: @rachel_eng @tom_sre — sounds like a caching/misaligned prefix issue after the rollout.

rachel_eng: Thanks for the ping. Which model variant was rolled? Any model-id or digest we can reference? Could be KV prefix key collision after we swapped model binaries.

tom_sre: Deploy logs show the controlled rollout finished ~1781998000. There's an automated cache migration job that was run. I can pull the job logs.
deploy-bot: release: redwood-instruct-2b v2026-03-09-rc4 deployed to prod (canary 5% -> 100%).
deploy-bot: job: kv-prefix-migration started (script v3).

rachel_eng: If the migration script used the old prefixing scheme (no model digest suffix), then old cached KV entries could be returned for sessions that kept the same prefix but now map to a new model. Looking into the runtime keygen code.

rachel_eng: Repro steps I'm running locally to verify:
```
# request 1
curl -s -X POST https://local-api:8080/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer X' -d '{"conversation_id":"test-abc","input":"What is our refund policy?"}'
# request 2 (same conversation_id right after)
curl -s -X POST https://local-api:8080/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer X' -d '{"conversation_id":"test-abc","input":"And what about late fees?"}'
```

rachel_eng: Observed on my end: second response sometimes contains text from another conversation. Traced to KeyGenerator.buildPrefix(session) returning a prefix that didn't include the model digest in some runtime instances.

rachel_eng: Patch idea: include model binary digest and rollout-id as part of the prefix hash. Quick patch landed here: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4896 (small keygen change + unit tests).

mike_infra: Short-term mitigation: we can purge the affected prefix keys for tenant ACME_INC. Use kvctl (internal) to list and delete.

mike_infra: Sample commands: 
```
# list prefixes for tenant
kvctl ls --prefix "tenant:ACME_INC:session:" --env prod
# purge a prefix
kvctl purge --prefix "tenant:ACME_INC:session:acme-1234" --env prod
```

mike_infra: I'll run a targeted purge after we confirm the exact prefixes.

alice_support: @acme_bob could you confirm you're okay with us purging session prefixes for ACME_INC? This will remove cached prefixes but won't drop models or data. We can also backfill if needed. :eyes:

acme_bob: Go ahead, please purge — we can tolerate a small spike in latency. Thanks.

mike_infra: Running purge now. Output: 
```
PURGE START tenant=ACME_INC prefixes=12
PURGE OK prefix=tenant:ACME_INC:session:acme-1234
PURGE OK prefix=tenant:ACME_INC:session:acme-5678
PURGE DONE elapsed=7.2s
```

acme_bob: Confirming — we've sent repeat requests and responses look correct now. No more unrelated text. :thumbsup:

rachel_eng: Great. We'll promote the keygen patch to canary (link above) and include an automatic prefix-version bump in the rollout pipeline so future deployments don't reuse old keys.

tom_sre: Plan: 1) backfill migration job to mark prefixes with new version tag, 2) patch runtime to include model digest (PR 4896), 3) add purge hook to rollout pipeline. I'll open an infra task for the pipeline changes.

alice_support: Created support ticket SUP-2026-4732 and credited ACME_INC for the incident window. Notifying customer success for follow-up.

rachel_eng: Quick note for postmortem: root cause = prefix keygen omission of model digest after migration script ran with older behavior. Impact = incorrect KV/prefix hits leading to mismatched context in some sessions. Severity: medium — customer-facing but no data corruption.

mike_infra: We'll schedule the pipeline change for tomorrow's maintenance window and coordinate a retro.

alice_support: ACME confirmed resolved, closing the thread after we verify for 24h. Thanks everyone.

acme_bob: Thanks all for the fast turnaround. Appreciate the credits and the explanation.

alice_support: Marking as resolved for now, will reopen if ACME sees a recurrence. :white_check_mark:
